responsibility: Provides the AVX10.2-512 media-style intrinsic interface for full-width 512-bit packed dot-product and SAD-style operations. It exposes the 512-bit byte and word dot-product accumulate families (`dpb*`, `dpw*`), packed FP16 dot products to FP32 (`_mm512_dpph_ps`), and masked `mpsadbw` forms, serving as the AVX10.2-512 header for neural-network and media arithmetic rather than generic arithmetic or conversion intrinsics.
